_comment: Where verify.yml runs its Windows sections (tools/ci/runner-router.cjs). Required sections stay on Blacksmith (blacksmith_windows) with idle qualified self-hosted hosts (ai-devops-windows-qualified) as extra capacity - owner ruling 2026-10-01: KEEP Blacksmith in the pool until WarpBuild is fully up; USE Blacksmith for runs that would otherwise get stuck. Owner 2026-10-02: use blacksmith to run your tests. WarpBuild Azure BYOC (warpbuild_windows, popcre-ci-use1, win-2022) is not a routing target; it is proven only by warpbuild-win2022-canary.yml. GitHub-hosted runners are never a routing target. Manual full-suite Blacksmith lane lives in windows-offline-blacksmith.yml.
_section_comment: Section-only lane (#1312, owner 2026-10-06: keep EDGE-ALIEN for lighter jobs; set it up to take one test piece at a time). A host labelled ai-devops-windows-section (and NOT ai-devops-windows-qualified) has measured-green sections with headroom (not the full matrix or every section); each idle one takes at most one pull-request section, chosen in section_lane_order. It never carries the qualified label, so it never takes windows-offline-complete or windows-reviewer-preferred.
_section_lane_order_comment: Only sections EDGE-ALIEN finished with at least 12 minutes of headroom under the 40-minute ceiling, fastest first (runs 37628253929 and 37725520505): 3 (15-16m), 4 (20.5-21m), 9 (22m), 10 (24m), 11 (26.5m), 6 (26-28m), 1 (28m). Excluded as too close: 2 (33-35m), 5 (36m), 7 (35-36m), 8 (39m, then timed out), 12 (36.5m). Add a section only after a measured pass with headroom. The list is shared by every section-only host: a second host may get the label only after it passes every listed section with headroom.
_linux_comment: Owner 2026-10-07 ("yes, point the checks at it"): idle self-hosted Linux hosts labelled ai-devops-linux (edge-dev3-linux, one job at a time) take linux-offline-shard sections as extra capacity, one section per idle host, in linux_lane_order. Busy, offline, unknown, a failed lookup, merge_group/schedule/manual events (no router) and fork heads all keep every section on Blacksmith, so merges never depend on one machine. The shard preflight in verify.yml requires every tool a suite would skip without (python, python3, ssh-keygen, pwsh, shellcheck); edge-dev3 carries pwsh and shellcheck user-locally in ~/.local/bin on the runner PATH. A host missing one fails the shard loudly instead of passing by skipping.
_linux_unfit_comment: A section selecting any of these never goes to a self-hosted Linux host. test-ai-lock-doctor.sh scans every process descriptor; on edge-dev3 (a busy desktop) one scan takes ~40s, the suite ~20 minutes, and a timing case failed (run 37697956258, job 113067788050).
